strategy.name: V11 + V3.7 + NET EXECUTION
strategy.objective: Maximise sustainable accepted cash profit per year, not bet count.
strategy.rule: Use frozen V11 selections and stakes, apply the V3.7 25% post-A$100K secured-high-water ratchet, and execute only when BET LOCKED at the best net executable price/fill available. The 30% non-core expansion remains shadow-only until genuinely forward evidence earns promotion.
strategy.selectionChange: NONE — current evidence does not justify loosening V11 live selection rules. The improvement is execution priority plus the already-promoted V3.7 risk policy.

execution.message: The stored start-around-10-Aug replay falls by about A$27.1K/year when winning prices are 5% worse, so price/fill quality is a first-class profit lever.

v37.note: V3.7 changes nothing before verified secured FY cash reaches A$100K. It is designed to reduce post-target give-back, not manufacture more predictive edge.

challenger.name: 30% non-core Australian expansion
challenger.warning: This is a same-history/hindsight screen, not a bankable forecast. Keep it shadow-only and record every added signal prospectively before any promotion.

evidence.planningNotPromise: Historical averages and planning means are model-equivalent evidence, not guaranteed accepted-cash income.
evidence.cashRule: Actual banked profit must use accepted stake, accepted price, charges/commission and settlement.
